Our Story

Founding Vision

Norzin Consultancy is the brainchild of two Tibetans with extensive backgrounds in international development and high-level business management.

Bridging Worlds

We bring together decades of experience working with major NGOs and the Central Tibetan Administration (CTA). Our journey has been shaped by involvement in high-impact projects with organizations like Monlam AI, FNF, and USAID.

We believe that sustainable growth comes from the harmonious union of localized cultural intelligence and cutting-edge business practices.
